notes.title: Trading card and challenge!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We just updated the game to version 1.0.6, added a new feature name Challenge.
After a successful 4-5 hearts night date with any girl now will give you her underpants (if your inventory not full), there are 5 pants totally in the game, give these pants to Masami to unlock this mode. From this point, affection goals in dating will be higher than normal! We also added a new achievement involved with this feature.
p/s: This mode is very hard, please consider before unlocking it.

notes.title: Adorable Crush autumn festival quick pitch!
notes.notes:
We are an indie developer team who loves creating visual novel and dating simulation games.
As a fan of HuniePop - an successfully dating simulation predecessor game. We created Adorable Crush that inherits the HuniePop core mechanic with many improvements such as Live2D animation to help character more lively and more interesting features.

Compared to our previous game, Adorable Crush focuses more on character interaction with memes and funny moments. We also spend most of the funding for this project to working artists, animators, professional writers and voice actors to make Adorable Crush become our most interesting games.

[b]The game will be released on 15 October. Don’t forget to add to wishlist to get upto 29% off launch sale! <3 <3 <3

Here is sort of things will be available in the game:

[b]Gorgeous girls with unique personality[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401857/94b7ba115ee295dc38cc833bd9b999ce15724f3e.gif[/img]

[b]An addicting match-3 style puzzle with free-move and indirect matching mechanic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401857/3aa09a2583ce18b29a758c7b8241c81e14ccdcc9.gif[/img]

[b]Catchy tune and upbeat tempo music[/b]
[b]Thousands of lines of dialog, fully and professionally voice acted by Japanese voice talents[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401857/6c0eccffd674078edf7386e200157cf02ab9a6ac.gif[/img]

[b]Beautiful background[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401857/4f91e98b808a39cc7ab9129fb1074df768f6f2fe.png[/img]
